title: 第17章 打的措手不及第18章 下三滥的战法
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
随着比赛拉开帷幕，五长老出现在演武场上。
“首轮采用海选制，能抵挡灵压三百息者，可进入下一轮，现在请全体参赛者出列。”
五长老的话音刚落，数百道身影冲上高台，清一色炼气三层以上的修为。
敢参赛的谁没有两把刷子，在场都是同族之人，谁也不愿在大庭广众之下丢人现眼。
五长老环顾四周，肃然道：“都准备好了，那我就开始了。”
话音刚落，恐怖的灵压席卷开来，演武场瞬间刮起了旋风。
参赛者们只觉得肩头一沉，仿佛有千斤重石压在身上，有些修为稍弱的当场一趔趄，差点直接摔倒在地。
“怎么这么强！
？我感觉自己一百息都坚持不住。”
“撑住！
无论如何我也要挺进第二轮。”
“金身诀给我发力！
我炼体三年，绝不能倒在这里。”
“…”
时间过去不到一百息，已有近三成参赛者倒下，剩下的也不少开始摇摇欲坠。
高台之上，苏宇赞叹道：“观五长老的气势，应该是筑基八层的修为吧，沈家当真是人才济济。”
沈雷渊淡然一笑，“苏兄谬赞了，听闻贵族又有一人突破虚丹，沈家远远不及。”
苏宇双眼一眯，打量了对方片刻，缓缓道：“沈兄早已踏入虚丹境，金丹有望，何必妄自菲薄。”
沈雷渊摇了摇头，感慨道：“金丹何其难，这辈子我恐怕只能止步假丹之境了，倒是苏家主还有一线机会。”
听到两人的讨论，几位长老也是感慨不已。

金丹之下尽蝼蚁，此话绝非妄言。
七成以上的筑基修士，受限于资质和寿元，终其一生都无法突破筑基九层。
而筑基九层的修士，唯有根基雄厚，血气未衰者，才能继续向前一步，凝聚出金丹雏形，这就是虚丹境。
此后还需不断打磨灵力，直到千锤百炼，终极一跃，才能成就不朽金丹。
这一步犹如天堑，阻挡了八成以上的虚丹强者，于是很多人另辟蹊径，借助外力压缩法力，最终凝聚金丹，这就是假丹境。
一颗金丹吞入腹，我命由我不由天。
这就是对金丹境的最好诠释，筑基境寿命极限也就是三百之数，而金丹强者可享八百春秋，号称上人。
上人即人上之人，超凡脱俗，不落凡尘，这就是金丹强者的威势。
此时现场已经进入白热化，两分钟过去，剩下之人已不足两成，大多数都是耳熟能详的存在。
“沈卿若、沈云…他们果然能通过首轮，咦！
？那个不是沈秋吗？”
放眼望去，却见一袭黑衣的沈秋直身而立，神态轻松，气定神闲，似乎根本没有受到灵压影响。
“没想到又杀出来一匹黑马，这一届真是人才济济。”
“如此游刃有余，看来沈秋已经突破炼气四层，真是令人叹为观止。”
“…”
content_en:
As the competition kicked off, the five elders appeared on the martial arts field.
"The first round will adopt an audition system. Those who can withstand three hundred breaths of spiritual pressure can advance to the next round. All contestants are now invited to come forward."
As soon as the fifth elder finished speaking, hundreds of figures rushed onto the high platform, all of them with cultivation levels above the third level of Qi Refining.
Anyone who dares to participate in the competition has nothing to do with it. Everyone present is from the same clan, and no one wants to be embarrassed in public.
The fifth elder looked around and said solemnly: "Everything is ready, then I will start."
As soon as he finished speaking, terrifying spiritual pressure swept across, and a whirlwind blew up in the martial arts arena.
The contestants felt as if their shoulders were heavy, as if a thousand pounds of stone were pressing down on them. Some of the weaker ones staggered on the spot and almost fell to the ground.
"Why are you so strong!
? I feel like I can't hold on for a hundred breaths. "
"Hold on!
No matter what, I will advance to the second round. "
"Golden Body Jue, give me strength!
I have been refining my body for three years, and I will never fall here. "
“…”
Less than a hundred breaths have passed, and nearly 30% of the contestants have fallen, and many of the remaining ones are beginning to falter.
On the high platform, Su Yu praised: "Judging from the aura of the fifth elder, he should be at the eighth level of foundation building. The Shen family is really full of talents."
Shen Leiyuan smiled calmly and said, "Brother Su, that's ridiculous. I heard that another member of the noble family has broken through the Xudan. The Shen family is far behind."
Su Yu narrowed his eyes, looked at the other person for a moment, and said slowly: "Brother Shen has already entered the virtual elixir realm, and the golden elixir is promising, so why belittle yourself."
Shen Leiyuan shook his head and said with emotion: "Golden elixir is so difficult. I'm afraid I can only stop at fake elixirs in this life, but the head of the Su family still has a chance."
After hearing the discussion between the two, several elders were also filled with emotion.
There are all ants under the golden elixir. This statement is absolutely not false.
More than 70% of the foundation-building monks, limited by their qualifications and longevity, will not be able to break through the ninth level of foundation-building throughout their lives.
As for the monks at the ninth level of foundation building, only those with strong foundations and strong vitality can continue to take a step forward and condense the prototype of the golden elixir. This is the virtual elixir realm.
From then on, one still needs to continuously hone one's spiritual power until one finally makes the final leap to achieve the immortal golden elixir.
This step is like a natural chasm, blocking more than 80% of the virtual elixir experts, so many people find another way to compress their magic power with the help of external forces, and finally condense the golden elixir. This is the fake elixir realm.
A golden elixir is swallowed into my belly, and my fate is determined by nature.
This is the best interpretation of the Golden Core Realm. The lifespan limit of the Foundation Establishment Realm is only three hundred, while those with a strong Golden Core can live for eight hundred years and are known as masters.
A master is a person who is superior to others. He is transcendent and does not fall into the mundane world. This is the power of a strong person with golden elixir.
At this time, the scene has reached a fever pitch. Two minutes have passed, and less than 20% of the people are left. Most of them are familiar people.
"Shen Qingruo, Shen Yun...they can indeed pass the first round, hey!
? Isn't that Shen Qiu? "
Looking around, he saw Shen Qiu, dressed in black, standing straight, with a relaxed and calm expression, as if he was not affected by spiritual pressure at all.
"I didn't expect another dark horse to come out. This class is really full of talents."
"With such ease, it seems that Shen Qiu has broken through the fourth level of Qi refining, which is really amazing."
“…”
